text: Here's Spare, live inside Nimiq Pay. Tap Connect. Spare only sees your addresses — it can't move a single coin without you.
Instantly, it finds every payment you've made — even through the hidden vaults Nimiq Pay pays from — and rounds each one up. Twenty-three everyday payments. And there's your spare change, waiting.
Every round-up is fair: sized to the payment, never more than half of it. Not a real purchase? One tap, and it's out.
Now the good part. One tap. One approval. Done. Your spare change is staked in your own wallet, earning rewards. No custody. No backend.
Want to save faster? Raise the round-up, or turn on a multiplier.
And it works for real. Two sweeps we made inside Nimiq Pay on testnet — a new stake, then a top-up — matching on-chain to the last luna.
